Jambon-beurre baguette bites.d: Crusty bread spread thick with sweet butter, thin boiled ham and little sour pickles, cut in twelve.
Jambon-beurre baguette bites.note: For the table while you wait.

Olives and cornichons.d: Warmed in oil with orange peel, thyme and garlic, with cornichons and pickled onions.
Olives and cornichons.note: A plain lunch at the back table.

Tony's spaghetti.d: San Marzano tomatoes crushed by hand, garlic cooked slow, basil and a knob of butter. Parmigiano on the side.

Potted plant dirt cups.d: Chocolate mousse and cookie soil in a clay pot, a mint sprig growing out the top.

Léon's malted vanilla milkshake.d: Milk, ice cream, malt and honey, frosted glass.
